items.title: Pay intensive B1 course and exam fee invoice
items.quote: Please transfer the course fee no later than 14 days after the date of this invoice, quoting the invoice number.
items.computation: The invoice is dated 29 January 2027 (a Friday). The due period is defined as '14 days after the date of this invoice' - this is a private commercial invoice, so the ordinary civil-law rule for event-triggered periods applies (§187(1) BGB): the day of the triggering event (the invoice date, 29 Jan) is not counted, and the period starts the next day. Day 1 = 30 Jan 2027, ... Day 14 = 12 Feb 2027. 12 February 2027 is a Friday and not a public holiday in Nordrhein-Westfalen, so no weekend/holiday extension under §193 BGB is needed. Final due date: 12 February 2027.
